To the said sum, 25% of the same (Rs.2,750/-) would have to be added as future prospects, since the deceased - 30 - C/W MFA No. 8621, 8649, 8658, 8677, 8697, 8703, 8941 & 8948 of 2019 was aged 44 years.

The resultant income would be Rs.13,750/-.
79.
Out of this income, 1/3rd of the same (Rs.4,583/-) would have to be deducted since the deceased was survived by husband and two children.

The monthly income would be Rs.9,167/-.
80.
As the deceased was aged 44 years, appropriate multiplier of '14' would have to be applied.

81. Consequently, the claimants would be entitled to a sum of Rs.15,40,056/- (Rs.9,167/- x 12 x '14')
towards loss of dependency.

82. The claimants being the husband two children of the deceased, each of them would be entitled to a sum of Rs.44,000/- towards "loss of love and affection" i.e., in all Rs.1,32,000/- and they would also be entitled to a sum of Rs.33,000/- under the "conventional heads".
